description: Guide pre-endoscopy management decisions for patients on GLP-1 receptor agonists (semaglutide, tirzepatide, liraglutide etc.), deciding whether to proceed, delay, or modify the approach based on GI symptoms, fasting status, and indication. Trigger when a clinician asks about GLP-1 RA and endoscopy, semaglutide before colonoscopy, Ozempic before procedure, or whether to hold a GLP-1 agonist before endoscopy.
